title: O+/O++ unit yield across V182o sessions
question: Is is_o_plus == 0 in sub-V182o_ses-260702 a session property or a subject-wide property? Determines whether the representative pilot can carry the requested O+/O++ functional-class contrast at all.

RETRACTION_20260829.what_this_receipt_measured: is_o_plus / is_o_plusplus as produced by unit_classification.classify_session_units, which is a SHUFFLE-BASED omission-contrast classifier.
RETRACTION_20260829.why_that_was_the_wrong_source: This project's actual O+/O++ population is NOT produced by classify_session_units. It comes from the R-family TEMPLATE-CORRELATION tables (omission/outputs/classification/grand_oplus_units.csv and grand_oplusplus_units.csv), consumed via assign_o_plusplus_from_template_table. classify_session_units leaves is_o_plus at 0 unless that separate template assignment step is run, so 'is_o_plus == 0' measured the absence of a PIPELINE STEP, not the absence of omission-responsive units.
RETRACTION_20260829.corrected_finding: sub-V182o_ses-260702 DOES have O+ and O++ units: 18 unique O+ units (21 table rows across the 'O+' and 'O*+' pattern types) and 4 O++ units, in FEF(12)/TEO(5)/MT(1). The corpus-wide historical figure is ~1,144 O++ conjunction units (oplusplus_conjunction_units_20260801.json), so a corpus-wide zero was implausible on its face and should have prompted a source check before the number was reported.
RETRACTION_20260829.row_vs_unit_inflation_recurred: 21 rows -> 18 unique units for O+ in this session. This is the same defect class already recorded in bug-oplus-row-vs-unit-count-inflation-20260817.json (a row count reported as a unit count). Deduplicate on unit_id before any O+/O++ count is quoted.
RETRACTION_20260829.claim_status: The claim 'V182o has zero O+ units, subject-wide' is WITHDRAWN. It was a method error.
RETRACTION_20260829.what_remains_valid: The per-session S+/S-/Other counts and total unit counts in this receipt are unaffected -- those come from the shuffle classifier's own well-defined output.
